title: EnableMenus - Debug
content:
Member of: Debug Script

Enables/disables menu rendering in the game.

Syntax:
Function EnableMenus(bool abEnable = true) Native Global DebugOnly

Parameters:
- abEnable: True to enable menu rendering, false to disable it.
    Default: True

Return Value:
None

Examples:
; Enable menu rendering
Debug.EnableMenus()

; Disable menu rendering
Debug.EnableMenus(false)

See Also:
- Debug Script
